gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-syloti: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps its lowercase compact, with short ascenders and an a whose lower bowl opens up. And Stencilia, the structural display heading above it, adds the punch while the sans-serif text just keeps reading smoothly.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Approachable is the first impression, thanks to Noto Sans Syriac Eastern and its curve endings that never crowd each other. Stencilia does its best work as a striking, structural heading; Noto Sans Syriac Eastern does its best as a friendly sans for text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tagalo: Stencilia gives the heading a structural, striking look, with a compact gap between its x-height and ascender line, while Noto Sans Tagalog stays clean beneath. Generous curve gaps keep the text open.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tagban: Crisp and open, this pairing starts with Noto Sans Tagbanwa, whose lowercase fills most of the height and whose curves keep clear gaps. And Stencilia brings a structural, striking display heading that gives those quiet lines something to hang from.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Stencilia opens with structure, leaving spacious gaps where its curves end and holding a compact gap above the x-height. Noto Sans Tamil is the contemporary counterpart: its text looks magnified without growing, and terminals stop far from the stem.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tc: Structural, striking letters up top, then Noto Sans TC below with large open counters in a, e and s. The curves open outward instead of curling in, so the whole pair feels generous.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Stencilia is structural and striking, with a compact gap between x-height and ascender line. Noto Sans Thai Looped supplies bold-looking lowercase with generous curve openings, so the heading's drama settles into a clean, professional text line.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-vithku: Noto Sans Vithkuqi reads clean and modern, its a, c, e and s all open-throated. Stencilia is the one to give big, short lines to, where its structural, striking display shapes can show off.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-zanaba: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a lofty x-height and wide gaps. Its strongest quality is crispness at tiny sizes, which gives Stencilia's structural, striking display heading a text partner that stays sharp.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-traditional: Stencilia's most distinctive trait is its spacious curve terminals, which give the structural heading an open, striking face. Noto Traditional Nushu follows with a broad-nibbed pen stroke whose bowls fill the line.
